name: When should I call a professional for a sewer smell?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for a sewer smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional if the sewer smell persists despite basic troubleshooting, such as running water in drains or checking for dry P-traps. A professional is also needed if the smell is strong, widespread, or accompanied by other issues like slow drains, gurgling sounds, or sewage backups. These symptoms can indicate a more serious plumbing problem, such as a main sewer line blockage or damage, which requires specialized equipment and expertise to diagnose and repair safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional if the sewer smell persists, is strong, or is accompanied by slow drains or gurgling. These symptoms may indicate a serious plumbing issue requiring expert help.
